title: Local null homotopies from bounded constant finite-projective complexes
statement: Let J be a site precoverage [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], X any object, R a commutative ring and F a bounded complex with finitely generated projective terms [def-weil-finitely-generated-module, def-weil-pbc-projective-module, def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Let E be its termwise constant realization [def-sf-site-constant-module-functor]. For any acyclic complex K of constant-R module sheaves [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules] and chain map alpha:E -> K there is an actual J-covering {Ui -> X} such that each restricted chain map is homotopic to zero [def-pur-localized-ringed-site].

proof.text: Exact constant realization takes zero terms to zero. Choose bounds a<=b for F and start with the zero partial homotopy above b. Exact slice restriction preserves acyclicity.

For a partial homotopy valid above k, the residual alpha^k-d_E h^(k+1) is a cycle by the chain-map equation and the equation in degree k+1. Factor it through cycles. Acyclicity makes K^(k-1) -> Z^k(K) epic. Apply the degreewise local lifting theorem on the slice to obtain h^k locally. Add a single-degree cochain to correct the partial homotopy, and transport along overFunctorMap.

Iterate b-a+1 times. Choose further coverings per distinct covering arrow, then use Presieve.bind and the site transitivity axiom; no closure under arbitrary repeated indexed composition is assumed. The resulting partial homotopy satisfies all equations at and above a. Below a its source is zero. The cochain-homotopy equivalence supplies the null homotopy, and exists_eq_ofArrows presents the presieve with index type of size max u v.

lean.statement: theorem exists_perfect_constant_local_null_homotopy (J : Precoverage C) (hJ : J.IsSiteForCoverings) (X : C) (R : Type (max u v)) [CommRing R] (F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ) (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero (F.X q)) [∀ q : ℤ, Module.Finite R (F.X q)] [∀ q : ℤ, Module.Projective R (F.X q)] (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u v} ((constantSheaf J.toGrothendieck RingCat.{max u v}).obj (RingCat.of R))) ℤ) (hK : K.Acyclic) (α : ((siteConstantModuleFunctorGeneral J.toGrothendieck R).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj F ⟶ K) : ∃ (I : Type (max u v)) (U : I → C) (f : ∀ i : I, U i ⟶ X), Presieve.ofArrows U f ∈ J X ∧ ∀ i : I, Nonempty (Homotopy (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{max u v} ((constantSheaf J.toGrothendieck RingCat.{max u v}).obj (RingCat.of R)) (U i)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map α) 0)
